description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain cancellation token functionalities, including task cancellation, callback execution, inter-silo and intra-silo coordination, and various cancellation scenarios. It uses xUnit for testing, and defines multiple test cases for verifying correct behavior of grain cancellation patterns.

classes.name: GrainCancellationTokenTests
classes.description: A collection of unit tests verifying the behavior of grain cancellation tokens in Orleans, covering various cancellation scenarios, cross-silo tasks, callback execution, and exception propagation.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Test fixture class that configures and initializes the Orleans test cluster with specific silo configurations.

classes.name: SiloConfig
classes.description: Silo configuration class that adds debugging logging to the silo builder.

methods.name: GrainTaskCancellation
methods.description: Tests cancellation of a grain's long-running task after a specified delay.

methods.name: MultipleGrainsTaskCancellation
methods.description: Tests cancellation across multiple grains with an interleaving delay.

methods.name: GrainTaskMultipleCancellations
methods.description: Tests multiple cancellations on a single grain with different call IDs.

methods.name: TokenPassingWithoutCancellation_NoExceptionShouldBeThrown
methods.description: Ensures no exceptions are thrown when passing a non-canceled token to a grain method.

methods.name: PreCancelledTokenPassing
methods.description: Verifies behavior when a pre-canceled token is passed to a grain method.

methods.name: CancellationTokenCallbacksExecutionContext
methods.description: Tests execution of cancellation callbacks within the correct context.

methods.name: CancellationTokenCallbacksTaskSchedulerContext
methods.description: Tests callbacks execution using a custom task scheduler context.

methods.name: CancellationTokenCallbacksThrow_ExceptionShouldBePropagated
methods.description: Checks if exceptions thrown within callback functions are correctly propagated.

methods.name: InterSiloClientCancellationTokenPassing
methods.description: Tests cancellation token passing from client to inter-silo grains.

methods.name: InSiloClientCancellationTokenPassing
methods.description: Tests cancellation token passing within the same silo.

methods.name: GetGrains
methods.description: Helper method to obtain a pair of grains, possibly on different silos, for testing inter-silo communication.

methods.name: WaitForCallCancellation
methods.description: Waits for a specific call ID to be canceled, with optional error checking.

methods.name: WaitForCallCancellation with multiple IDs
methods.description: Waits for multiple call IDs to be canceled.
